unmetRequirements.evidence: The ground shadow includes large box-shaped dark regions with straight cut edges beyond the rider's silhouette, clearest in level-03 (a parallelogram reaching right of the bicycle) and raised-03 (a rectangular slab behind it), and also visible in level-04 to level-07 and raised-01. map() (lines 117-128) returns the bounding-box distances of the frame, pelican and leg groups as geometry outside their 0.03 margin, and shd() (lines 131-136) uses those proxy distances in its 12*h/t penumbra term.
